title: Internal: Retrieving Customer Account Information
summary: This document explains how to use the tool get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve a customer’s bank accounts (checkings and savings). It covers when to use it (eligibility checks, pre-closure requirements, customer service lookups) and the required user_id plus returned fields: account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, and date_opened.
